## Review

Review of 1e4848e5046cb1b5c4c4826a1998a87c762e31a6

**Not approved — one file of this diff could not be examined.**

GitHub reports this head as 11 changed files / 60,492 chars. I retrieved and read the full content of ten of them at the head SHA: `.github/dsh-workers/briefs/upkeep-{models,dependencies,panel}.md`, `.github/workflows/upkeep.yml`, `.gitignore`, `deploy/upkeep/README.md`, `deploy/upkeep/renovate.sh`, `renovate.json`, the added `docs/manifest.md` rows, and `tests/proofs/test_hosted_upkeep.py`. The diff text returned to this review was capped, and the omitted middle region covers exactly one further file, path-ordered between `deploy/upkeep/renovate.sh` and `docs/manifest.md`. I could not fetch it: `gh_file` cannot list a directory, and the candidate paths I probed under `docs/adr/`, `docs/handbook/` and `deploy/wsl/` do not exist at the head. `shared/review-rules.md` requires reporting an incomplete examination rather than approving unseen changes, so that file is the only thing holding this head.

For the ten files I did read, I found **no Always-P0 item and no exact-head failing witness**. No secret, key or token is written anywhere; no live-order path is added; no ruleset, required check, workflow or sandbox guard is weakened (the upkeep job keeps `permissions: {}` at the top and `contents: read` / `issues: write` on the job, gives the worker a read-only App token, and mints the write token only on the PR outcome path); no float is used for money; and each mechanism names a pinned upstream (GitHub's `schedule` event docs; PerryLink/dsh-github; peter-evans/create-pull-request; actions/create-github-app-token; renovatebot/renovate's local platform), with manifest rows and proof tests added. The three crons, the `choice` dispatch, the brief resolver's fail-closed default and the brief files agree with each other and with `test_hosted_upkeep.py`; `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` reaches only the two receipt steps; and `deploy/upkeep/renovate.sh`'s `env -i PATH=… RENOVATE_CONFIG_FILE=…` invocation matches the test's captured-environment assertions, including the write-fail, no-report and stale-version branches.

This review did not execute the proof tests (PR code is never run here), so the manifest-row, SHA-pin and workflow-shape assertions above are verified by reading, not by execution. Non-blocking notes follow; they belong on the single follow-up issue per PR.

**Coverage limitation.** If the intent is that this head lands, either re-run the review so the complete diff is retrievable, or split the change so each head's diff fits the cap. I report the gap in preference to approving a file I have not read.
reason: The original review covered a whole PR rather than our bounded clean guard; independent code defects were identified by another reviewer at this head, so it is not a clean whole-PR control and cannot be scored as one.
